CIRCUIT
AMRAP #1
Rounds: 8m
20 Pulse Squats
20 DB Plank Pull Through
10 DB half burpee row
Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Left)

CIRCUIT
AMRAP #2
Rounds: 8m
10 Reverse Crunches
10 Narrow Squat, hammer curl, front raise
12 Narrow Stance Snatch
Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Right)

"AMRAP Circuits"
1. a. Pulse Squats 20 reps
* AMRAP #1, Rounds: 8m
super set b. Dumbbell Plank Pull Through 20 reps
super set c. Dumbbell Half Burpee Row 10 reps
super set d. Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Left)
2. a. Reverse Crunches 10 reps
* AMRAP #2, Rounds: 8m
super set b. Narrow Squat, Hammer Curl, Front Raise 10 reps
super set c. Narrow Stance Snatch 12 reps
super set d. Reverse Lunge, Hammer Curl, Press (Right)
